newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark plans big computer investment.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark plans big computer investment.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Friday it planned to spend over 100 million crowns on a major investment programme in computer infrastructure over the coming years.

"These investments are an important element in Tele Danmark's preparations to take on increased competition in the liberalised telecoms sector," Tele Danmark private customer manager Henning Boergesen told Reuters.
"It is not possible to give a precise investment figure but it will exceed 100 million Danish crowns and stretch over a period of time I cannot divulge," he added.

He said the investments embraced computer hardware and software, improved personal computer systems for Tele Danmark staff, the setting up of an electronic intranet system, a new data warehouse and an automatic call centre to improve services for consumers.
